FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about our game development services.

FAQcard.title: How much does it cost to develop a game?
FAQcard.description: A hyper-casual mobile game starts from $5,000–$15,000. Mid-range mobile games range from $20,000–$80,000. Complex multiplayer or PC games can be $100,000+. We provide detailed estimates based on your specific concept.

FAQcard.title: Which game engines do you work with?
FAQcard.description: We primarily work with Unity (for cross-platform mobile, PC, AR/VR) and Unreal Engine (for high-fidelity desktop/console games). We also develop HTML5/WebGL games with Phaser and PixiJS.

FAQcard.title: How long does game development take?
FAQcard.description: Hyper-casual games take 4–8 weeks. Mid-range mobile games take 3–6 months. Complex multiplayer or PC/console games typically take 6–18 months depending on scope.

FAQcard.title: Do you handle app store submission?
FAQcard.description: Yes. We manage the full App Store and Google Play submission process including store listing optimization, screenshots, descriptions, and compliance with platform guidelines.

FAQcard.title: Can you add monetization to my game?
FAQcard.description: Absolutely. We implement in-app purchases, ads (AdMob, Unity Ads), subscription models, and battle pass systems designed to maximize revenue without compromising the player experience.
